info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Collateral Management Collections API
info.description: The Collateral Management Collections API enables financial institutions to effectively manage and track collections associated with collateralized loans. This API supports the initiation of collection processes for outstanding debts, allowing for prompt and efficient handling of accounts. Typical consumers include banking operations teams and financial services applications that require management of collateral-related transactions. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their debt recovery strategies and ensure compliance with relevant regulations.
